nota: Personal life of Commander Alex Rivera (fiction). Unlocks: day = survive until that day, mission = main missions completed.

diario.title: Day 1 — Still breathing
diario.text: The Selene-7 hit harder than any simulator ever did. My ribs hurt, the antenna is gone and the tanks are empty. ARIA keeps talking, which helps. I promised Luna I'd call her from the Moon. I will keep that promise, even if I have to build the phone myself.

diario.title: The silence
diario.text: No wind, no birds, no traffic. The quiet here has weight. At night I count the stars I know from the backyard at home: the same ones Luna and I used to name. Sam always laughed that I named them after snacks.

diario.title: Patched
diario.text: First leak sealed. My hands were shaking inside the gloves. Dad used to fix the roof every winter and swear at the shingles; I swore at the habitat. Same family tradition, different roof.

diario.title: Luna's drawing
diario.text: I found Luna's drawing folded in my suit pocket. A yellow Moon with a smiling astronaut and a dog in a helmet. She gave Biscuit a helmet. I taped it above the bed so it is the first thing I see.

diario.title: Water from the dark
diario.text: Ice from the shadowed crater, melted into the tank. The first sip tasted like metal and victory. LCROSS found this water in 2009; tonight it kept me alive. Thank you, NASA nerds.

diario.title: Dreams of rain
diario.text: I dreamed of the day Sam and I got married, when the sky opened and everyone ran under the trees. I woke up laughing in a place where it has never rained. I miss mud. I never thought I'd write that.

diario.title: The rocket breathes
diario.text: Structure and power are back. When the systems lit up I talked to the rocket like a horse: easy, girl, we're going home. ARIA pretended not to hear.

diario.title: Contact
diario.text: The relay is up. For three seconds there was only static, then Mission Control said my name. I had to turn the mic off so Houston wouldn't hear me cry. Ana Ortega said Luna watches the Moon every night.

diario.title: Coming home
diario.text: Tanks full, every subsystem green. Tomorrow the window opens. I packed Luna's drawing, the photo of Biscuit and a pebble of regolith for Mom. If you're reading this, it means I left it behind on purpose: the Moon should remember somebody tried.

album.caption: Sam, Luna and Mom at the Kennedy viewing stands. Luna holds a sign: GO MOM GO!

album.title: Luna's drawing

album.title: Biscuit
album.caption: Our golden retriever. Steals socks, fears the vacuum, loves everyone.

album.title: Married in the rain
album.caption: Sam and me, soaked and laughing. Best day of my life (so far).

album.title: Selene-7 crew
album.caption: Me, Jonas Weber and Dr. Aiko Tanaka in training. Jonas brought the bad jokes.

album.title: Earthrise
album.caption: Taken from orbit, the day before landing. Everyone I love is on that blue marble.
